finance.title: Finance and ERP
finance.pickClinic: Select a clinic in the header to work with finance and inventory.
finance.emptyCashboxesHint: Add a cashbox via API or seed data to track cash and card receipts. This screen does not create cashboxes.
finance.emptyTx: No finance transactions for the selected period.
finance.txTotalsHint: A quick look at turnover for the selected filters. Detailed reports are in Analytics.
finance.txNoTotals: No data to calculate totals yet.
finance.emptyPayrollPolicies: Payroll policies are not configured yet.
finance.noActiveDoctors: No active doctors in this clinic
finance.emptySalaryDoctor: No accruals for this doctor yet.
finance.emptyProducts: Inventory is not set up yet. Add products in admin or via API.
finance.invHistoryHint: Filtered by selected product, warehouse, and period.
finance.emptyInvTx: No movements for the selected filters.
finance.stockPair: Current stock for the selected product/warehouse pair

discounts.title: Discounts and promotions
discounts.intro: Create and edit discounts. They apply automatically at payment.
discounts.emptyHint: Add the first discount for this clinic.
discounts.percentOrAmount: Enter either a percent or an amount.
discounts.valueRequired: Enter a percent or an amount.
discounts.serviceRequired: Select a service for this discount type.
discounts.doctorRequired: Select a doctor for this discount type.

prepayment.title: Prepayment
prepayment.clinicEnabled: Prepayment is on for this clinic
prepayment.clinicOnHint: Booking asks for payment using the rules below.
prepayment.clinicOffHint: Booking does not ask for payment; the visit is confirmed immediately.
prepayment.rulesDisabledHint: Turn on prepayment above to configure rules (none / partial / full by service and doctor).
prepayment.emptyHint: Add a prepayment rule for this clinic.
prepayment.deleteConfirm: Delete this prepayment policy? This cannot be undone.

gateway.title: Payment gateway
gateway.intro: Choose one payment system. Enter details from that provider’s dashboard. One checkout is active per clinic.
gateway.keysSaveFailedRetry: Could not save checkout keys. Try again.
gateway.yookassaShopIdHint: Shop ID from the YooKassa dashboard (Settings → Shop ID). Used to create payments and refunds.
gateway.leaveBlank: Leave blank to keep the saved key
gateway.yookassaSecretHint: Secret key from the YooKassa dashboard. Stored encrypted. Enter a new key only when rotating it.
gateway.tinkoffTerminalHint: Terminal identifier from the Tinkoff Kassa dashboard. Issued when you connect.
gateway.tinkoffPasswordHint: Terminal password from the Tinkoff Kassa dashboard. Used to sign requests. Stored encrypted.
gateway.sberLoginHint: API login for Sberbank acquiring / SberPay. Confirm it in the bank contract and dashboard.
gateway.robokassaLoginHint: Store login from the Robokassa dashboard.
gateway.robokassaPass1Hint: First password (Result URL, Success). Used when accepting payments. Stored encrypted.
gateway.robokassaPass2Hint: Second password (Result URL, Fail / notifications). Verifies Robokassa notification signatures.
gateway.stripeSecretHint: Secret key from Stripe Dashboard (Developers → API keys). Secret key is used to accept payments. Test key is for sandbox. Stored encrypted.
gateway.stripePublishableHint: Public key for client forms (e.g. Stripe Elements). Not required for server-side payment creation.
gateway.paypalClientIdHint: App Client ID from PayPal Developer Dashboard (My Apps & Credentials). Live for production, Sandbox for tests.
gateway.customNameHint: Display name only. Keys and payments are configured outside this system.
gateway.customIdHint: Identifier or login for the custom checkout (optional).
gateway.customKeyHint: Secret key or password for the custom checkout (optional).

loyalty.emptyPackages: No packages yet. Add them in admin or via API.

loyalty.needPatientId: Paste a patient UUID above to look up passes.

loyalty.emptyWallet: This patient does not have a wallet yet.
loyalty.emptyWalletTx: No transactions for the selected wallet yet.
loyalty.campaignsHint: LOYALTY_* tasks are not created when the patient has notifications off or has not opted in (for re-engagement). Respect daily and monthly limits.
loyalty.reengagement: Re-engagement (no visit for a long time)
loyalty.skipSmsDup: Do not duplicate SMS for expiring (if already sent today)
loyalty.maxLoyaltyMonth: Max LOYALTY_* tasks per patient / month (UTC)
loyalty.reengagementDays: Days without a visit for re-engagement
loyalty.lastRun: Last run: expiring {{expiring}}, high balance {{highBalance}}, re-engagement {{reengagement}}; skipped: limits {{limits}}, cooldown {{cooldown}}, campaign overlap {{cross}}, SMS duplicate {{sms}}, opt-out {{optOut}}

commerce.title: Store (Commerce)
commerce.subtitle: Option commerce.store_network · separate from ERP inventory
commerce.noOrgBody: Link the administrator to a SaaS organization to enable option gates.
commerce.pwaHint: A simple storefront: cards of active catalog items, without cart or checkout in this release. Turn on when you are ready to show assortment to clients.
commerce.showInMenu: Show the Store section in the patient app menu
commerce.deleteLocConfirm: Delete sales point “{{name}}”? Stock on this location will be affected. This cannot be undone.
commerce.deleteNomConfirm: Delete catalog item “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
commerce.importJournalHint: Upload audit. Each UI upload sends its own Idempotency-Key; repeating the same key and profile does not duplicate data after a successful import.
commerce.networkHint: Read-model across all clinics in the organization: locations, catalog, total on-hand quantity.
commerce.networkTotals: Network totals: {{locations}} locations, {{items}} catalog items, on hand {{qty}}
commerce.locationsHint: Within the clinic; one can be the default for UX and stock.
commerce.balancesHint: Quantity of each item at the location; also changed by goods-in / goods-out documents.
commerce.needLocation: Add at least one sales point to track stock.
commerce.noItems: No catalog items — create them below.
commerce.movementsHint: Goods in and goods out at one location; transfer (goods_transfer) writes off from “from” and receives at “to”. Shortage on out/transfer is rejected.
commerce.needLocAndNom: A sales point and catalog are required to post a document.
commerce.needSecondLoc: Create a second location to post transfers.
commerce.needTwoLocs: A transfer needs at least two locations
commerce.pickDifferentTo: Choose a destination different from the source
commerce.needPositiveLine: Add a line with an item and quantity > 0
commerce.nomenclatureHint: SKU in the Commerce context (not ERP products).
commerce.cardsHint: Cards appear after you create active items below or import CSV.
